verses.text: Ix yalan junxo ab'ix tik Jesús t'a heb' winh, xchi icha tik:
--Ol wal t'ayex chajtil ol aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios aj satcha'anh. Ay jun winh rey ix yak'och sk'inh jun yuninal yik snupnaji.
Ayik wan syamchajoch jun k'inh chi', ix chekanb'at heb' schekab' winh, yik tz'ik'jikot heb' awtab'il yuj winh. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol heb' ix kot t'a jun k'inh chi'.

Yuj chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a juntzanhxo heb' schekab': Ixikek, b'at alek t'a heb' awtab'il chi' wu'uj to wach'xo yaj tas ol swa heb' wuj t'a tik. To ix wak' miljok juntzanh nok' wakax yet' juntzanhxo nok' nok' b'ak'ech yak'ji serwil. Listaxo yaj smasanil tikne'ik. Yuj chi', ixikek, alek t'a heb' to elanhchamel skot heb' t'a jun nupnajel tik, xchi winh rey chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' schekab' winh chi' yala'. Palta haxo heb' awtab'il chi', maj stak'kotlaj sb'a heb'. Ay jun ix b'atkan yil slu'um. Ay junxo, ix b'at t'a snegocio.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' ix yamankan heb' schekab' winh chi'. Ix yak'an chukal heb' t'a heb'. Hanheja' ix miljicham heb' yuj heb'.
Haxo winh rey chi', ix kot yowal winh. Yuj chi', ix schekb'at juntzanh heb' soldado winh, yik b'at miljokcham heb' ix mak'ancham heb' schekab' winh chi'. Haxo schonhab' heb', ix nhusjikantz'aok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a juntzanhxo heb' schekab': Wach'xo yaj smasanil tas yik jun nupnajel tik, palta a heb' awtab'il chi', manh ton smojok to a heb' tz'awtaji.
Yuj chi' ixikek t'a calle. Jantaknhej heb' tz'ilchaj eyu'uj, tzeyik'kot heb' t'a jun k'inh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at juntzanhxo heb' schekab' winh chi' t'a calle. Jantaknhej heb' ix ilchaj yuj heb', heb' chuk yet' heb' wach', ix molb'aj heb'. Yuj chi', ix te b'ut'ji jun pat b'aj ix och jun k'inh chi' yuj heb' anima.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochk'och winh rey chi' yil heb' ix k'och chi'. Ix yilan winh, ay jun winh manhoklaj k'apak pichul yik nupnajel ayoch yuj.
Yuj chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: Ach wetanima'il, ¿tas yuj tzach komon ja t'a jun nupnajel tik? Ina manhoklaj k'apak pichul yik nupnajel ayoch u'uj, xchi winh. Maj tak'woklaj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a juntzanh heb' schekab' ayek' yet' ta': Tzek'ek pitan jun winh tik. Tzeyik'anb'at winh. Tze yumankanb'at winh b'aj ay k'ik' k'inal. Hata' ol ok' winh. Ol sik'ik'ok winh yok'i, ol juch'uch'ok ye winh yuj yab'an sya'il, xchi winh.
Icha chi' syal jun ab'ix tik, yujto tzijtum heb' awtab'il yuj Dios, palta jaywannhej heb' sik'b'ileli, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel sb'a heb' winh fariseo chi'. Ix slajtian sb'a heb' winh t'a spatik Jesús, tas ol yutok heb' winh yak'anoch t'a yib'anh yuj slolonel, yujto snib'ej heb' winh yak'anoch t'a yib'anh.

Yuj chi', ix schekb'at jaywanh heb' sk'ayb'um heb' winh t'a Jesús chi' yet' jaywanh heb' spartido winhaj Herodes. Ix b'at yalan heb' t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, kojtak to te yel tzala'. Kojtak paxi, a jun k'ayb'ub'al snib'ej Dios, tza k'ayb'ej t'a yel. Junlajan tzutej a pensar t'a spatik heb' anima, yujto max ach och k'elan t'a heb'.
¿Tas tz'aj tza na'? Ha juntzanh tumin sk'anjiel t'ayonh yuj winh yajal t'a Roma, ¿ay am sleyal skak'a', ma to ma'ay? xchi heb' t'ay.
Palta yojtakxo Jesús to chuk sna'an heb' t'a spatik. Yuj chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha ex tik, chab' sat ex. ¿Tas yuj tzin eyak' prowal?
Ch'oxek wil junok tumin tz'ak'ji t'a winh yajal chi', xchi t'a heb' winh. Yuj chi', ix ch'oxji jun tumin chi' yila'.
Ix sk'anb'anxi t'a heb' winh: --¿Mach ayoch yechel t'a jun tumin tik? ¿Mach ay yik jun b'i tz'ib'ab'iloch tik? xchi t'a heb'.
--Haton yechel winh yajal t'a Roma yet' sb'i winh, xchi heb'. --Yuj chi', a tas yiktaxon winh yajal chi', ak'ek t'a winh. Palta a tas yiktaxon Dios, ak'ek t'ay, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', tonhej ix sat sk'ol heb'. Yuj chi' ix el heb' t'a stz'ey Jesús chi', ix b'at heb' b'i'an.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh saduceo ix k'och t'a Jesús. Ha heb' winh chi' tz'alani to manh ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak. Yuj chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'ay:

--Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a winhaj Moisés tz'ib'annakkani: K'inalok ay junok winh schami, skan ix yetb'eyum winh, palta malaj junok yuninal winh. Tato icha chi', haxo junok yuk'tak winh tz'ik'anxikan ix, yik wach' tato tz'aj yuninal junxo winh chi', ichato yuninal winh ix cham chi' yaji. Icha chi' yaj yalankan winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha junel, ay ukwa'anh heb' winh yuk'tak sb'a ek'nak t'a ko kal. Ha winh b'ab'el winak ik'jinak jun ix ix, palta cham winh. Malaj yuninal winh alji yet' ix. Haxo winh yuk'tak winh ik'anpaxkan ix.
Palta champax junxo winh chi', malaj pax yuninal winh ajkan yet' ix. Icha chi' ajpax winh yoxil. Ek' heb' winh yukwanhil t'a ix.
Chamel heb' winh yukwanhil, ichato chi' b'i'an, scham ix.
Haxo yik ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, ¿mach junok heb' winh ol ik'an ix? yujto yik'nak ix heb' winh yukwanhil, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Tonhej tzex somchaji, yujto manh eyojtakok tas syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Manh eyojtakokpaxi jantak spoder Dios.
Yujto ayik ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, manhxalaj ik'lajb'ail. Yujto lajan ol aj heb' yet' heb' yángel Dios ay t'a satcha'anh.
Palta toxon chekel yaji to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak. ¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyil t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, tas yalnakkan Dios, ayik yalannakkani?

Ha in ton tik, sDiosal in winhaj Abraham, sDiosal in winhaj Isaac, sDiosal in pax winhaj Jacob, xchi. Yuj chi' wach'chom chamnak heb' winh, palta kojtak to manh satnakok el heb' winh t'a junelnhej, yujto yalnak Dios to sDiosal heb' winh yaji.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima juntzanh ix yal chi', ix te sat sk'ol heb'.
Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' winh fariseo to ix em numnaj heb' winh saduceo chi' yuj Jesús, yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey.
Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Snib'ej winh syak' prowal Jesús. Yuj chi', ix stz'ak sk'anb'ej winh t'ay:
--Ach in k'ayb'umal, ¿b'aja junok cheknab'il t'a ley Moisés niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil? xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Tze xajanej Dios Kajal t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, t'a smasanil he pixan yet' t'a smasanil he pensar.
Haton jun cheknab'il tik, niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil.
Haxo junxo cheknab'il tik, ken manh lajanok yelk'och yet'ok, xchi icha tik: Ichaokab' eya'ilan he b'a, ichaokab' chi' he xajanan heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej chab' cheknab'il tik, syalelk'ochi, wan ko k'anab'ajan sley Dios smasanil yet' jantaknhej tas tz'ib'yajkan yuj heb' schekab', xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Aytoek' heb' winh fariseo chi', ix sk'anb'an Jesús t'a heb' winh:
--¿Tas xe chi yuj Cristo? ¿Mach ay yinhtilal tze na'a? xchi t'a heb' winh. --Ha Cristo chi', yinhtilalkan winhaj rey David, xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jesús: --Palta yuj Yespíritu Dios yalnak winhaj David chi' to a Cristo, Yajal yaj t'a winh, xchi icha tik:
Ha Dios Kajal alannak t'a Wajalil icha tik: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab' tik, masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Dios t'a Wajalil, xchi winh.
Icha chi' yutejnak winhaj David yalankani to a Cristo Yajal yaj t'ay. Yuj chi', ¿tom yinhtilalnhej winhaj David chi' yaji? xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Palta malaj junok mach ix pakan t'ay. Yuj chi', atax t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok mach stek'b'ej sb'a sk'anb'an junokxo tas t'ay.
